figures.shows: One channel with three keys at 0, 1 and 3 seconds and values 0, 2 and 1, drawn three times: as a step, as straight lines and as a cubic spline with tangents
figures.caption: The three curves meet at the keys and differ between them: the step jumps, the line turns at each key and the cubic curve leaves each key along its tangent.
figures.alt: A line chart of value against time from 0 to 3.5 seconds with three black dots at the keys. A dashed orange step line stays flat and jumps at each key. A blue straight line joins the keys. A dotted green curve passes through the keys and overshoots above 2 between the second and third key. All three stay flat after the last key.
